scripts.text: I am actually a bit worried but there must be a reason for our 'wise' high minister.
scripts.translation: 我其实有些担心，不过我们这位“英明”的大臣肯定自有打算。

Our scout who went to Rapine is being attacked by cute child looking monsters.
scripts.translation: 我们派去拉菲尼营地的侦察兵，正遭到一群长得像可爱小孩的魔物袭击。

scripts.text: So we need to hunt them inevitably, and you are the one for hunting them since you are not from Rapine.
scripts.translation: 所以必须猎杀它们。你不是拉菲尼族人，正好适合执行这项任务。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^990099A child on the flower^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.

scripts.text: Are you aware of the child looking flower, Pinguicula? People say there has been a mutant of that flower.
scripts.translation: 你听说过长得像孩子的花——捕虫堇吗？听说最近出现了变异种。

scripts.text: They are very violent and aggressive so the troops from Rapine have been sent to slay them. Please go to check up and treat it before they are spread all over the area.
scripts.translation: 它们十分凶暴，拉菲尼部队已经奉命去讨伐。请在它们扩散到整个地区前，前去调查并处理。

scripts.text: Some mineral collectors are missing, and it seems to be done by nepenthes for sure.
scripts.translation: 有几名矿石采集者失踪了，肯定是猪笼草干的。

scripts.text: Nepenthes is similar to Mandragora. We gotta do something in order to protect people from more damage.
scripts.translation: 猪笼草和曼陀罗魔花很像。我们必须采取行动，避免更多人受害。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^990099Dangerous Plant Removal^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.

scripts.text: They've discovered the centipede larva habitat. We can remove them now so there will be less mom centipedes.
scripts.translation: 他们发现了蜈蚣幼虫的巢穴。现在清除幼虫，就能减少成年的母蜈蚣。

scripts.text: Would you find them and kill them? You will have to be careful with the mom centipedes around them.
scripts.translation: 你能找到并消灭幼虫吗？记得小心周围的母蜈蚣。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^990099Larva Extermination^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我为你准备了名为消灭幼虫的委托。打开任务窗口，查看委托详情和交付对象。 ^990099^000000^990099^000000

scripts.text: Miners heading to Nidhogg's nest, it's been reported that the miners were attacked by a strange thing.
scripts.translation: 前往尼德霍格巢穴的矿工报告说，他们遭到一种奇怪的东西袭击。

scripts.text: It's said that it was human looking water, but it must be an evil thing which is not water spirit. Perhaps the Nidhogg Dungeon is the origin so please visit there to check up.
scripts.translation: 据说那东西像是人形的水，但肯定不是水精灵，而是邪恶的存在。源头也许在尼德霍格地下城，请去调查。

scripts.text: Tatachos were originally beautiful birds, and they could fly. But since they settled here where there is no natural enemy, they started to be fat and lazy,
scripts.translation: 塔塔乔原本是美丽的鸟，也会飞。后来它们定居在这个没有天敌的地方，渐渐变得肥胖又懒惰，

scripts.text: And finally they became like now, so ugly birds. You will be a good natural enemy for them.
scripts.translation: 最终就变成现在这副丑陋的模样。你正好可以当它们的天敌。

scripts.text: We don't know how far the infestation of this insect may spread so please exterminate as many as you spot.

scripts.translation: 这是刚从矿场同事那里收到的消息。

scripts.text: The baby dragons living near Yggdrasilberry roots are destroying the grounds near the mines. It will get dangerous if we don't take care of it.
scripts.translation: 生活在依格德拉希尔树根附近的幼龙正在破坏矿区周边。再不处理，情况会变得很危险。

scripts.text: Please wipe out the baby dragons near Yggdrasilberry.
scripts.translation: 请去消灭依格德拉希尔树根附近的幼龙。

scripts.translation: 拉菲尼营地附近的沼泽里发现了一种新的种族——那迦。

scripts.text: The problem is that they are primitive intellectuals and are violent.
scripts.translation: 问题是它们虽然有一定智慧，却十分好斗。

scripts.text: We will have many conflicts with them in the future if they expand their colony. Please go eliminate the adult Nagas.
scripts.translation: 如果它们继续扩张聚落，以后肯定会起冲突。请去消灭成年那迦。

scripts.text: Can you go there in person and take a look? ...

scripts.translation: 也可能只是幻觉，所以请亲手摸摸它，确认是不是真有活物。

scripts.translation: 蜈蚣繁殖太快是个问题，它们的食量也威胁着我们的生计。

scripts.translation: 它们会吸收布拉迪姆矿物，还会破坏矿区。
